notes.title: Updates and Improvements
notes.content:
Changes included in this version:

[list]
[*] add * to category label for items not yet donated
[*] make "Tell Me" the default option for Storyteller
[*] make abilities visible in skills tab before unlocking
[*] preserve music when refreshing the same scene
[*] update item stats for several items
[*] add more variety to some hangout dialogue audio
[*] clarify some Éclair story mission dialogue
[*] fix: can't donate wine to the museum
[*] fix: typo in the gym with Bruno
[*] fix: display correct max volume for vehicle stash
[/list]

Please enjoy the game :)

notes.content:

[*] fixed typo: safe crach -> safe crack

[*] add: text options for maze guy on first dialogue
[*] fix: lengthened backpack close from movement delay

Please enjoy the game :)
